ننفلق (form VII)
# نَنْفَلِقُ (nanfaliqu) /nan.fa.li.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْفَلَقَ (infalaqa)
# نَنْفَلِقَ (nanfaliqa) /nan.fa.li.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَلَقَ (infalaqa)
# نَنْفَلِقْ (nanfaliq) /nan.fa.liq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْفَلَقَ (infalaqa)
